The '''DRPV-78 Rocket Pack''', also known as a '''HSS Thruster Pack''', was a model of [[Rocket pack/Legends|rocket pack]] manufactured by [[Greshnohr]]. The pack could reach heights of three hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and a vertical distance of five hundred meters and carried enough fuel for twelve bursts.
